text: just seen a guy on the victoria line in august. synthetic trainers. gym socks. shoe spray sat in his tote bag like a first aid kit. no insoles. no allbirds. just him and four stops of pure heat and his own choices. Respect honestly.

caption: august on the underground is a personality test
why_this_brand: The shoe spray plus synthetic trainers plus an August tube carriage is the exact sweaty-commuter pain Allbirds' wool and tree fibre shoes exist against.

text: packed for a four day trip last night. three pairs. the work shoes that still need breaking in. the plimsolls that eat my heels. the gym ones for a gym i won't find. no allbirds. just me kneeling on the carpet sitting on a cabin bag like it owed me money. i need help.
base_video: Creator kneeling on a bedroom floor beside a half zipped cabin bag with shoes spilling out, sitting back on their heels, staring at the camera with the flat face of someone who has lost.
audio: slow sad trending sound, low volume
caption: be honest, how many pairs are you taking
why_this_brand: Packing three pairs into a carry on is the one shoe problem Allbirds solves by being the pair that does commute, city and weekend.

text: my flatmate does this thing before a full day out. stands at the front door over a pile of shoes doing maths. blisters on tuesday or sore feet by three. no gel insoles. no heel grips. no allbirds. just her and a doorway and a decision that will haunt her by noon. she's built different and wrong.
base_video: Creator stood in a hallway in socks, coat already on, looking down at a pile of shoes by the door, then up to camera with a slow head shake.
caption: the front door shoe maths is real
why_this_brand: Gel insoles and heel grips at the front door name the exact crutches people use when no single pair is comfortable enough to just walk out in.

text: watched a girl walk borough market to london bridge in flat ballet pumps. no socks. no plasters. no allbirds. a whole afternoon of walking and a face like nothing was happening. by the bridge she was walking on the sides of her feet and still smiling. brave. genuinely brave.
base_video: Creator stood against railings near a busy market or bridge, drink in hand, looking off to one side then straight down the lens with a small disbelieving nod.
audio: quiet trending sound with a city walking vibe
caption: we all know one of these
why_this_brand: Ballet pumps with no support on a full day of London walking is the precise everyday-footwear gap Allbirds fills.

text: new guy at work has been breaking in the same smart shoes for three weeks. plasters on both heels. spare socks in his drawer. tape. actual tape. no allbirds. just him limping to the printer and calling it an investment. couldn't be me.
base_video: Creator sat at a desk in an office or kitchen, eating lunch from a tub, chewing slowly, eyes flicking off camera then back to lens, one small shrug.
caption: three weeks of breaking them in is not a flex
why_this_brand: Smart work shoes that need breaking in, plasters and tape is the stiff-synthetic pain Allbirds' wear-them-out-the-box shoes sit against.
